jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List account jobs via SPI GET /jobs on {account}.workable.com/spi/v3.

jobs.get.title: Get job
jobs.get.description: Fetch a single job by shortcode via SPI GET /jobs/{shortcode}.

candidates.list.title: List candidates
candidates.list.description: List candidates via SPI GET /candidates. Optional email, shortcode, stage, limit, sinceId, maxId, createdAfter, and updatedAfter filters.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a single candidate via SPI GET /candidates/{id}. Returns the full candidate profile.

stages.list.title: List stages
stages.list.description: List recruitment pipeline stages via SPI GET /stages.

members.list.title: List members
members.list.description: List account members via SPI GET /members. Optional limit, sinceId, maxId, role, shortcode, email, name, and status filters.

events.list.title: List events
events.list.description: List scheduled events (calls, interviews, meetings) via SPI GET /events. Optional type, limit, sinceId, maxId, startDate, endDate, candidateId, shortcode, memberId, context, and includeCancelled filters.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Workable connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.
